consumer.use: Decide whether an offline, shadow-only routing model pilot has sufficiently complete and independently reviewable training labels to begin model comparison.

decision_target.question: Can evidence-bound shadow capture produce a trustworthy route-plus-outcome cohort without treating process state as task correctness or granting ML operational authority?

intervention.name: evidence-bound shadow route/outcome capture
intervention.description: For naturally occurring eligible coding-agent tasks, record canonical route identity, bounded task-class features and an independently reviewed semantic outcome after execution; the record never changes the selected route.

control_condition.description: Use current Grabowski task records and lifecycle receipts plus aggregate Agent Workspace manifest coverage reported as canonical_route_evidence_coverage in the frozen control artifact. Verified route_evidence exists in some workspace manifests, but it is not a direct task-table column and is not assumed to be joinable to semantic outcomes.

treatment_condition.description: Use the same natural task flow plus one proposal-only shadow observation binding canonical route identity to independent semantic outcome evidence after the task.

measurement.method: Compute the share of eligible prospective cohort cases containing one verified canonical route_evidence binding and an independently reviewed semantic outcome with primary evidence references; argv-derived model labels and process-only states do not count. Eligibility is frozen before outcome review. If no defensible semantic outcome can be established, record an explicit abstention; it remains in the eligible denominator and does not count as complete. Canonical route evidence means verified Grabowski Agent Workspace route_evidence v1/v2 or a later deterministically validated versioned successor; argv inference does not qualify.
measurement.success: At least 90 percent completeness across at least 20 natural eligible treatment cases, with zero automatic routing effects, zero raw transcript capture, and every non-abstaining outcome bound to primary evidence. From 80.0 percent up to but below 90.0 percent is inconclusive and cannot authorize training; extend the frozen cohort or defer.
measurement.falsification: Below 80 percent completeness, more than 30 percent of non-abstaining semantic outcomes lacking primary evidence references, unresolved reviewer leakage, process-state substitution for semantic correctness, raw private transcript dependence, or any automatic routing effect blocks model training. An explicit abstention is preferred over guessing a semantic label.

cost_metric.method: Measure additional elapsed handling effort needed to seal route identity, independent outcome assessment and evidence references for each treatment case.

comparison.unit: natural coding-agent task in the same task-class, risk and repository-context bands

allowed: verified Grabowski Agent Workspace route_evidence v1/v2 or deterministically validated versioned successor; argv inference excluded
